left_summary: Left changes obter_desconto() to return the discount as a fraction (0 to 1) instead of a percentage (0 to 100), and updates preco_final() to use the fraction directly.
right_summary: Right adds the function preco_frete(), which applies the discount returned by obter_desconto() to the shipping cost, dividing it by 100.
justification: Left changes the value returned by obter_desconto() from a percentage (15) to a fraction (0.15). Right adds preco_frete(), which reads that value and divides it by 100, assuming a percentage. In the merge, preco_frete() receives a fraction, so a VIP customer gets a 0.15% discount on shipping instead of the 15% Right intended.

justification: Left changes listar_pedidos() to return a generator instead of a list. Right adds gerar_extrato(), which iterates over the returned value twice (to compute the total and to build the lines). In the merge, the generator is consumed by sum(), so the statement has the correct total but no lines, unlike in Right.
